newsitem.title: USA: UPR may get close to 50 pct of Pennzoil.
newsitem.headline: UPR may get close to 50 pct of Pennzoil.

text.p: Union Pacific Resources Group Inc may report today that it has received acceptances of more than 40 percent and up to 50 percent of Pennzoil Co shares in its hostile bid when the first part of its tender offer closes.
"UPR's offer is compelling and even if there is a higher offer and you tender now, you will still get the higher offer," said Howard Weil, a spokesman for investment.
He said this would put severe pressure on the Pennzoil board, without whom there could be no deal as the company has a series of poison pill and other anti-takeover defenses.

"But if you find that half of your shareholders now back UPR, then you cannot ignore that. To stay with the Pennzoil board you would have to believe that they are capable of getting a higher price for the company," Weil said.
He noted that $84 per share in cash and UPR stock was a "good offer", but added that it may go higher.
No-one from Union Pacific or Pennzoil was immediately available for comment.
